coaching.headline: We won the first two teamfights and cashed neither; they won three and cashed all three — that's the whole 10–21 loss.
coaching.team: Four of five lane reads were ours or even, and we took the 11-min fight at our Fangtooth 3-1 and the 15-min fight at our outer tower 3-1 — then banked nothing from either. From 17 to 20 minutes the game flipped on picks: the 17.2 skirmish went 0-2 under our own tower and traded straight into their Fangtooth at 18.2, the 18.3 fight opened 4v5 with Murdock already down, and the inner and outer towers fell by 19.8. The call: when we win a fight, the next 90 seconds belong to Fangtooth or a tower — not to resetting into their picks.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Won fights converted 0-for-2 against their 3-for-3, and the 17–20 minute pick cascade: Kallari and Steel caught at 17.2 bought their 18.2 Fangtooth, then two towers by 19.8.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock's lane read even into Drongo and the trouble came outside it: three deaths caught alone — 13.7 by The Fey (the outer tower fell at 15.1), 17.8 by Drongo (their Fangtooth and our inner tower followed), 25.9 by The Fey again. And at the 24.9 Orb Prime fight the macro shows Mr_Meat31 alive and never joining a 2-3 loss. The carry's rotations decide those two fights; move with the group when Orb is up.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari won the jungle read all game and led the team with 8 kills — but objective damage was 0, and the two won teamfights at 11 and 15 minutes cashed nothing. The 17.2 death traded into their 18.2 Fangtooth. On a pick hero the kill is step one; step two is spending the numbers advantage on Fangtooth or a tower before resetting.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Greystone won the offlane read against Grux all game, but the scoreline was 2/5/1 with only 372 objective damage — the winning lane never became pressure. Caught at 8.6 by Grux, and the 18.6 death fed the inner-and-outer tower cascade. A won offlane should be shoving and rotating into the fights the team kept taking short-handed.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

grux.loadout: Marrow (Taste of Iron + Jealousy), augment Red Mist, crest Iceskorn Talons
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 28 minutes, fewer deaths than about 94% of Grux offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Warlord's Challenge at top rank: 90s base, about 62.1s by the end (31% shorter) from 45 ability haste: Alternata 10, Draconum 15, Augmentation 20.
6 takedowns (4 kills, 2 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Grux dealt 24,801 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +142 physical power from items.

Penetration: Alternata 12; against Greystone (level 15 estimated: about 96 physical armor, 84 after penetration) and Kallari (level 15 estimated: about 93 physical armor, 81 after penetration) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Alternata (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Marrow (Eternal): Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. (65% effectiveness for AoE attacks, 15% against monsters.)
Taste of Iron (Eternal minor): Damaging a hero with a DoT increases your damage by 6% for 3s.
Jealousy (Eternal minor): Deal 1%-8% increased damage as your Health falls from 100% to 20%.

Sustain: 4% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; 8,730 healing recorded.
Toughness: +525 health, +85 physical armor, +40 magical armor; took 33,408 damage, mitigated 35,244, died 1 times.

card.lesson: Warlord's Challenge came back about every 62s instead of 90s by the end (31% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
